notes: Translated main.do variable construction (per-capita mills/wrights over pcmean, wheat_suit = wheat_tmean<=5, riv_rug26count/1000, msuit26mean = wheat_suit*riv_rug26count, county_id from GAZ_CNTY) and the Tables.do Table 2 / Table 3 regressions into fixest feols with SEs clustered by county_id. Coefficients and N=298 matched from the first run. Attempt-1 computed the ivreg2 widstat (Kleibergen-Paap Wald F, equal to the squared first-stage t-stat with one instrument) with no small-sample adjustment; after comparing with the claims, the final run applies Stata's (N-1)/(N-K)*G/(G-1) cluster adjustment to the first-stage vcov, which reproduces 19.90 / 16.96 / 16.17.
